contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #062: Projective contact classification and the LeBrun–Salamon conjecture.

Let X be a smooth simply connected complex projective contact Fano manifold of dimension 2n+1 with n>=1, contact sequence 0->F->T_X --theta-->L->0, Pic(X)=Z[L], and a covering family of free contact lines. Put Z=X times X and M=L boxtimes L. For any proper integral algebraic space Y over C and dominant p:Y->Z, regular sections W12 of p*(T_X boxtimes L) and W21 of p*(L boxtimes T_X) have the same contact value xi. The target is existence and uniqueness of B in H0(Z,M) with p*B=xi.

definitions.simply connected: the complex analytic manifold X^an has trivial fundamental group
definitions.proper integral algebraic space: no normality, flatness, connected-fiber, or reduced-fiber hypothesis is added
definitions.positive part: the intrinsic sum of the positive-degree summands of the globally generated bundle f*T_X

contexts.statement: Integer orders are used only for the local arithmetic obstruction in the descent argument; no geometric hypotheses or conclusions are encoded here.

definitions.order: a function from a monoid to Z with explicitly assumed power compatibility for the specified element and exponent

red:determinant: det(F)=L^n and -K_X=L^(n+1), hence the contact line of a contact Fano manifold is ample.
red:simply-connected: a smooth complex Fano manifold is simply connected and has free Picard group identified with H^2(X,Z).
red:alternatives: the given contact structure is either primitive Picard rank one or one of the standard incidence and projective-space structures.
lines:free-cover: the primitive case has a smooth irreducible family of parametrized free contact lines with smooth dominant evaluation.
A covering family of free L-degree-one maps supplies a smooth irreducible open Hom family whose evaluation is smooth and dominant.
lines:positive: the intrinsic positive part P_f of a free contact line has trivial tangent quotient and theta(P_f)=0.
At a general point the contact-line tangent directions span P(F_x) and form a smooth possibly disconnected Legendrian variety; the dimension-three endpoint is treated separately.
lines:cone-addition: two components of a smooth projective Legendrian variety with a nonorthogonal pair have dominant affine-cone addition.
lines:suitable-pair: there are two free contact lines with nonzero Levi pairing and positive tangent subspaces summing to F_x.
sm:vertical-cokernel and sm:fixed-ends: the nodal two-line evaluation cokernel is L_x and there is no first-order smoothing fixing both outer values.
sm:very-free: a degree-two immersion g has tangent splitting O(2)+O(1)^(2n), smooth full Hom space, and submersive two-point evaluation.
sm:full-germ: normalization of the unmarked stable-map component retains the entire nearby parametrized degree-two Hom family.

ext:normal-products: products of flat nodal-curve families over a normal integral base with smooth geometrically integral entire generic fibers are integral and normal, with the stated divisorial points.
ext:trees: an unmarked stable genus-zero degree-two source is smooth or two degree-one components with one node and no contracted component.
ext:contact-order: at a boundary trait uv=tau^r the relative contact differential has order at least r on each component.
ext:differential-order and ext:pole-table: the contraction differential has order r on the contracted component, and the invariant bivector has mixed-component pole order at most r.

ext:moving-pair: the normalized unmarked universal square and coarse descent yield a proper integral algebraic space dominating X times X, both regular vector lifts, symmetry, and the full Hom-family identity.
The reduced contact-value image S0 in Tot(L boxtimes L) is finite over Z; its finite normalization S agrees with S0 and is etale over one dense base open.
For every test line of either factor type meeting that base open, every dominating component of the normalized finite image pullback has degree one.

Every prime divisor on Z is met transversely in its prescribed dense smooth open by a general test line of at least one of the two factor types, avoiding any prescribed codimension-two exceptional set.
A divisorial ramification index e>1 gives a smooth transverse pullback curve germ of index e, contradicting all-sheet degree-one splitting; therefore q is unramified at every height-one source point.
Equal local dimensions and purity make q etale everywhere; simple connectedness forces degree one, so S0 is Z and its tautological value is a unique descended section.

Under exactly CTX_CONTACT_VALUE, for every proper integral algebraic space Y over C, every dominant morphism p:Y->X times X, and every pair of everywhere regular vector sections W12 in H0(Y,p*(T_X boxtimes L)), W21 in H0(Y,p*(L boxtimes T_X)) satisfying (theta boxtimes 1)(W12)=(1 boxtimes theta)(W21)=xi, there exists exactly one B in H0(X times X,L boxtimes L) such that p*B=xi.
des:family: applying descent to the moving-pair construction gives a symmetric tensor B with the displayed identity on the full nearby parametrized family, including the diagonal.
jet:value-velocity and jet:diagonal: very freeness gives an open set of values and velocities, and the full family identity forces B in I_Delta^2 with second symbol theta^2 everywhere.
jet:criterion: on a connected compact complex contact manifold a symmetric B with second diagonal symbol theta^2 generates all ordinary first jets of L and gives contact transitivity.
jet:transitive: the effective identity component of algebraic contact automorphisms acts transitively on every contact Fano manifold in thm:main.
hom:adjoint: effective connected algebraic contact transitivity and an ample contact line identify the manifold and its given contact structure with the adjoint variety of a simple Lie algebra.
thm:main: every smooth connected projective contact Fano manifold of dimension at least three, with its given contact structure and polarization, is a simple adjoint contact variety.
tw:section: a closed positive quaternionic-Kahler manifold has a projective contact Fano twistor space, and its sphere bundle and Fano simple connectedness give simple connectedness of the base.
tw:section: the complex twistor isomorphism to a Wolf model and LeBrun's normalized metric uniqueness recover a base isometry without presupposing preservation of a chosen real structure.
thm:quaternionic: every closed connected positive quaternionic-Kahler manifold of real dimension at least eight is homothetic to a compact symmetric Wolf space and has parallel curvature.

claims.natural_statement: For every e in Nat with 2<=e and every m in Int, (e:Int)*m is not 1. Consequently, in any monoid A, if order:A->Int satisfies order(z^e)=(e:Int)*order(z) and order(t)=1, then z^e is not t. This is only an integer-order lemma and does not formalize des:descent.
claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib.Tactic

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace ContactValueDescent

theorem exponent_mul_integer_ne_one
    (e : Nat) (he : 2 <= e) (m : Int) :
    (e : Int) * m != 1 := by
  intro h
  have he0 : (0 : Int) <= (e : Int) := Int.ofNat_nonneg e
  have he2 : (2 : Int) <= (e : Int) := by exact_mod_cast he
  have hm : (1 : Int) <= m := by
    by_contra hn
    have hm0 : m <= 0 := by omega
    have hp : (e : Int) * m <= 0 :=
      mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos he0 hm0
    omega
  have hp : (e : Int) <= (e : Int) * m := by
    calc
      (e : Int) = (e : Int) * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
      _ <= (e : Int) * m := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm he0
  omega

theorem power_order_obstruction
    {A : Type*} [Monoid A] (order : A -> Int)
    (e : Nat) (he : 2 <= e) (z t : A)
    (hpower : order (z ^ e) = (e : Int) * order z)
    (ht : order t = 1) :
    z ^ e != t := by
  intro hroot
  apply exponent_mul_integer_ne_one e he (order z)
  calc
    (e : Int) * order z = order (z ^ e) := hpower.symm
    _ = order t := congrArg order hroot
    _ = 1 := ht

end ContactValueDescent

#print axioms ContactValueDescent.exponent_mul_integer_ne_one
#print axioms ContactValueDescent.power_order_obstruction
